In the 10th-century ruins of Angkor Wat, a private dinner is served by candlelight in the warmth of the open air at the temple of Prasat Kravan. Seamlessly arranged by the @Amansara_Angkor team, private dining experiences allow for a unique sense of intimacy, with menus crafted to reflect individual wishes in magical locations. From a sunset cruise on Tonlé Sap to dinner by the Lap Pool, memories are forged for a lifetime.

As the festive season approaches, host your perfect celebration with #Amansara via the link in bio.
